tours.name: Request Time Off (with calendar)
tours.description: Learn how to submit a time off request: choose the leave type, give a reason, pick your dates in the calendar, save the request, and check that it is waiting for your manager.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to submit a time off request: choose the leave type, give a reason, pick your dates in the calendar, save the request, and check that it is waiting for your manager.

steps.title: Open Time Off
steps.description: The Time Off app is where you submit leave requests and follow their approval.

description_i18n.en_US: The Time Off app is where you submit leave requests and follow their approval.

steps.title: New request
steps.content: Click New to start a time off request.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to start a time off request.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank time off request in a window on top of your calendar.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank time off request in a window on top of your calendar.

steps.title: Time Off Type
steps.content: Click here to open the list of time off types.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to open the list of time off types.

steps.description: The leave type decides how your days are counted and who has to approve the request. Opening the field shows the types available to you.

description_i18n.en_US: The leave type decides how your days are counted and who has to approve the request. Opening the field shows the types available to you.

steps.title: Choose the type
steps.content: Click the type of leave you want to take.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the type of leave you want to take.

steps.description: The number in brackets next to a type is the balance you have left for it. Pick the type that matches your absence, for example Annual Leave for a holiday.

description_i18n.en_US: The number in brackets next to a type is the balance you have left for it. Pick the type that matches your absence, for example Annual Leave for a holiday.

steps.title: Reason
steps.content: Type a short reason for your request, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type a short reason for your request, then press Tab.

steps.description: Say briefly why you need the time off. Your manager reads this note when deciding, so a clear reason helps your request get approved faster.

description_i18n.en_US: Say briefly why you need the time off. Your manager reads this note when deciding, so a clear reason helps your request get approved faster.

steps.title: Open the calendar
steps.content: Click the date field to open the calendar.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the date field to open the calendar.

steps.description: Both dates start as today. Opening the calendar lets you choose when your leave begins and ends.

description_i18n.en_US: Both dates start as today. Opening the calendar lets you choose when your leave begins and ends.

steps.title: Pick your last day
steps.content: Click the last day of your leave in the calendar.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the last day of your leave in the calendar.

steps.description: Click the final day of your leave in the calendar. For a single day off, click the same day again. The number of days is calculated for you.

description_i18n.en_US: Click the final day of your leave in the calendar. For a single day off, click the same day again. The number of days is calculated for you.

steps.title: Apply
steps.content: Click Apply to confirm your dates.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Apply to confirm your dates.

steps.description: Apply confirms the dates you picked and closes the calendar. The Duration field now shows how many days you are requesting.

description_i18n.en_US: Apply confirms the dates you picked and closes the calendar. The Duration field now shows how many days you are requesting.

steps.title: Save & Close
steps.content: Click Save & Close to submit your request.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Save & Close to submit your request.

steps.description: Nothing is sent until you save. Saving submits the request to your manager for approval.

description_i18n.en_US: Nothing is sent until you save. Saving submits the request to your manager for approval.

steps.title: My Time
steps.content: Open the My Time menu to check your request.

content_i18n.en_US: Open the My Time menu to check your request.

steps.description: After saving, check that your request was recorded. Start from the My Time menu.

description_i18n.en_US: After saving, check that your request was recorded. Start from the My Time menu.

steps.title: My Time Off
steps.description: My Time Off lists all your requests, with the newest first, so you can find the one you just made.

description_i18n.en_US: My Time Off lists all your requests, with the newest first, so you can find the one you just made.

steps.title: Check the status
steps.content: Your new request is at the top. Click the status to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: Your new request is at the top. Click the status to finish.

steps.description: A new request starts as To Approve and changes to Approved or Refused once your manager decides.

description_i18n.en_US: A new request starts as To Approve and changes to Approved or Refused once your manager decides.
